rows.n: Penang Road Famous Jin Kor Char Kuey Teow
rows.w: ~40-year charcoal stall in the Penang Road cendol lane; MICHELIN Guide-listed for its cockle-and-prawn char koay teow with pronounced wok hei.
The definitive Air Itam asam laksa; CNN Travel ranked Penang asam laksa among the World's 50 Best Foods. Reopened after a pandemic pause; now weekends only.
